provision_review.why: The 7601.10.30.00 line gives a Special rate of Free for KR and points to 9903.90.09, which sets a 70% column 2 rate for Russian Federation products. The pre-fix line-B branch used only the column 2 (18.5%) and General (2.6%) rates, so Korea got 2.6% and Russia 18.5%. The post-fix adds the Special branch and the Russia 70% branch.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The pre-fix composition derived the line B (HTS 7601.10.30.00) base rate from General Note 3 columns alone, so it omitted heading 9903.90.09's clause charging Russian-Federation products 70% in lieu of column 2 (it applied the 18.5% column 2 rate) and omitted the Special subcolumn entirely for line B (Korea got the 2.6% General rate instead of Free), and it likewise omitted the overlay exception clauses the cited chapter 99 notes state (9903.85.02 aluminum carve-out from Brazil IEEPA 9903.01.77; the 9903.05.03 annex and 9903.05.07 metals exclusions from Brazil 301 heading 9903.05.01).
triage.triage_notes: Multi-defect module: this single composition file carries at least five distinct fidelity corrections, so the one reported kind is the dominant one. (a) unrepresented_clause x4 - new rules origin_is_russia + russia_heading_9903_90_09_rate_of_duty + line_b_special_rate_applies wired into mfn_ad_valorem_rate, plus 'origin_is_brazil and not entry_is_line_b' in ieepa_component_rate versions[0] and 'if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0' in brazil_section_301_component_rate versions[1]. (b) wrong_period_or_effective_date x2 - section_232_aluminum_component_rate boundary moved 2026-07-22/23 -> 2026-07-20/21, and brazil_section_301_component_rate window opened 2026-07-23 -> 2026-07-22. (c) untraceable_branch/amount_mismatch x1 - the China fentanyl term 'fentanyl_china_additional_duty_rate + ' (heading 9903.01.20) was removed from ieepa_component_rate versions[0] because U.S. note 2(s) confines that heading to entries 2025-02-04..2025-03-03, before every grid date; note the module file for 9903.01.20 was already deleted in the immediately preceding commit 86d35779d, so the import removal here is bookkeeping but the formula term removal is a live rate change (China entries were over-charged). (d) mechanical parts in the same diff: page-177 excerpt fixed to 'As provided for in heading 9903.01.32...', new proof atoms grounding the 2026-02-24 IEEPA cutoff in EO 14388 / EO 14389 (FR 2026-03832) with no formula or date change there, plus rationale/summary prose and citation-path list expansion. Provisions read through the pinned-release resolver: HTS 7601.10.30.00 confirms 'Rates of duty (1-Special): Free (A,AU,BH,CL,CO,D,E,IL,JO,KR,MA, OM,P,PA,PE,S,SG)', 'Rates of duty (2): 18.5%' and 'Footnote [other]: See 9903.90.09.'; HTS 9903.90.09 confirms 'Articles the product of the Russian Federation, as provided for in U.S. note 30(c)... Rates of duty (2): 70%'; FR 2026-14542 confirms 'DATES: July 22, 2026'. The chapter-99 page-508/page-509 excerpts quoted in the new proof atoms did not resolve verbatim in the release the resolver picked (us-rulespec-2026-08-03, page offsets shifted; page-508 there is chapter 99 note text that does contain the 7601.10.30 subheading list), so those excerpt strings were not independently verified - the heading text itself settles the substance. The section 232 boundary fix is corroborated by the rev12-consolidation overlay module carrying effective_from '2026-07-21' at both the parent and this commit, so the pre-fix composition mis-timed entries on 07-21 and 07-22. File is module.kind: composition (hand-assembled, signed with manual_exception 'composition'), not encoder-generated, but it is a rulespec/v1 module with real formulas and proof atoms, so it is treated as a rule module. PR body (#1192) still records the older judgment calls ('Brazil 301 window opens 2026-07-23 in the composition grid vs FR 2026-14542 DATES 2026-07-22', '19/19 cases') that this commit supersedes (18 cases per the commit message); companion test file and the encoding manifest changed alongside.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this three ways and each attempt failed. (1) "New coverage, not a defect": refuted — pre-fix the formula already returned a value for line B Russian and Korean entries (`origin_is_column_2_country` lists `"RU"`, so RU got the 18.5% column-2 rate and KR got the 2.6% General rate), and the pre-fix summary already claimed "column and special-subcolumn selection under HTS General Note 3", which line A implemented and line B did not; the pinned release shows HTS 7601.10.30.00 reading `Rates of duty (1-Special): Free (...KR...)` plus `Footnote [other]: See 9903.90.09.`, and 9903.90.09 reading `Articles the product of the Russian Federation, as provided for in U.S. note 30(c)... Rates of duty (2): 70%`, so the pre-fix output disagreed with the source for cases the module covered. (2) "amount_mismatch fits better": no existing numeric parameter was corrected (18.5% remains right for Cuba); the fix adds a source clause ("in lieu of" column 2) as a new branch plus a new named parameter, and adds the omitted Special subcolumn branch — the signature of unrepresented_clause. (3) "not_a_rule_module": the file is `format: rulespec/v1` with `rules:` carrying formulas, versions, dtypes, proof atoms and a companion test file, not a compose spec/registry/ledger, so it carries encoded meaning. The decisive edits sit exactly at the cited rule_path `rules[mfn_ad_valorem_rate].versions[0].formula`.
triage.verifier_notes: Reviewer caveats. (a) This commit bundles at least three defect kinds; the reader's anchor rule is the clause-addition one, but a kind-splitting reviewer could file separate cases for wrong_period_or_effective_date (`section_232_aluminum_component_rate` boundary `effective_to: '2026-07-22'` -> `'2026-07-20'` / `effective_from: '2026-07-23'` -> `'2026-07-21'`; `brazil_section_301_component_rate` window opening moved to 2026-07-22 per FR 2026-14542 DATES) and untraceable_branch (the 9903.01.20 import and its `fentanyl_china_additional_duty_rate +` term removed because U.S. note 2(s) confines that heading to entries 2025-02-04..2025-03-03, before every date the composition covers). The page-177 excerpt edit ("As provided in" -> "As provided for in") is provenance-only/mechanical. (b) Provenance nuance, not affecting the verdict: the new proof atom citing `chapter-99/page-509` with excerpt `"7601.10.30"` does not match what the resolver returns for page-509 (that page shows 8541/8542 subheadings); `7601.10.30` appears in the page-508 text, and the page-508 atom's note-30(c) excerpt is not in the page-508 body either. The resolver reported `fix_time_corpus_match: provision_file_absent_at_corpus_ref` and fell back 16 releases to `us-rulespec-2026-08-03-ecps-pit-tariff-union`, so chapter-99 page numbering likely shifted between revisions; worth a separate provenance check rather than treating it as a counterargument to the fidelity finding. (c) Scope note: this module is hand-authored/assembled (`module.kind: composition`, signed with manual_exception "composition") rather than encoder-applied, so if the corpus is meant to measure encoder-produced defects, this case measures hand-wired composition logic.
